title: K-flat tensor with a single module has its termwise model
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and choose its derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], equipped with the source K-flat derived tensor product. Let $P$ be an unbounded cochain complex of $A$-modules which is K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], and let $M$ be any $A$-module. Then $Q(P)\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}M[0]$ is isomorphic to $Q$ of the complex whose term in degree $i$ is $P^i\otimes_A M$ and whose differential is $d_P\otimes 1_M$. No flatness or boundedness hypothesis on $M$ is imposed.

proof.text: K-flatness of P passes to the homotopy quotient. The derived tensor counit is invertible on its first factor. Compose this counit with the comparison between tensoring a cochain complex with the degree-zero single complex and tensoring each term with M, and with the quotient-to-derived-category comparison. This is the existing source construction QObjTensorSingleFunctorObjIso; no boundedness or flatness of M is needed.

noncomputable def QObjTensorSingleFunctorObjIso (P : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso C (.up ℤ)).kFlat P) (F : C) :
    Q.obj P ⊗ (singleFunctor C 0).obj F ≅
      Q.obj (((tensorRight F).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P)
